scenarios.prompt: White to move. Checkmate the enemy king. Every legal move is allowed; the computer plays Black.
scenarios.explanation: Knights jump, so they are the only pieces that can move before the pawns do. Bring them towards the centre, attack pawns that are not protected, and look for forks.
hints: Count the material before each capture: keep at least as much as your opponent.
A pawn that promotes becomes a queen: a passed pawn can decide the game.
